tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa'i dka' gnas kyi don mdor bsdus bshad pa zab don bcud kyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po dang / /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan/ /khyab bdag rje btsun mus pa chen po yi/ /zhabs la gus pas btud nas rtsa brgyud kyi/ /bla ma rnams kyi gsung rab gsung rgyun la/ /brten nas dges mdzad rdo rje'i mngon rtogs kyi/ /zab don legs bshad bcud kyi snying po spel/ /'dir rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad rgyud gsum du 'du ba las/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum yin la/ thabs rgyud la yang / rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod pa/ gsum du 'dod pa/ bzhir 'dod pa/ lngar 'dod pa/ drug tu 'dod pa rnams las/ 'dir bzhir 'dod pa'i lugs yin la/ gnyis su 'dod pa la'ang mi mthun pa du ma yod kyang 'gal ba cher med de rang rang gi lugs tha dad pa yin no/ /bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ bya ba'i rgyud du lha'i nga rgyal med par bris sku sogs la rje dpon lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len par gsungs/ spyod rgyud las/ grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len par gsungs/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las mnyam bzhag tu dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug ste rjes gshegs su gsol ba'i tshul gsungs/ bla med la yi dam dang dbyer med kyi tshul gyi nyams su len par bshad/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde bzhir byed pa ni/ gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de las lhag /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor chen po de las lhag /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bla med kyi don yang rim gnyis su 'dus pas/ de la gnyis te/

bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /'dir ni dang po 'chad la/ de la yang rtsa rgyud du dkyil 'khor drug gsungs shing / yang ljon shing du mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad cu/ las rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams gsungs pa las/ 'dir snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yin la/ de la yang gang gis bsgom pa'i gang zag gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ nam bsgom pa'i dus/ bsam pa ji lta bus bsgom pa/ bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor te lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ rang rang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la las dang po pas bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ gnas ni gang du bsgom pa'i sa/ /gang du mnyam bzhag 'phel 'gyur ba/ /gnas ni bzang po yongs su brtag /rang gi khyim du'o/ /zhes yid dang mthun pa'i rang khyim du bsgom par bshad/ cung zad brtan pa thob nas dur khrod dang chu 'gram sogs su bsgom par bshad cing / brtan pa chen po thob nas nges pa med pa yin no/ /gsum pa la thun gcig gi dbang du byas na/ mtshan dus bsgom/ thun gsum du byed na/ rtsa rgyud las/ thun gsum du bsgom pa rnam par bsgom nas zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dag ldan du/ snga gung dgong gsum mam/ nyin mtshan gnyis la gsum gsum du bshad pa'i lugs gnyis gsungs pas de ltar bya/ yang tshig rkang du thun bzhir bshad de/ dgong thun/ srod thun/ thor thun/ snga thun rnams so/ /brtan pa thob nas ni thun gyi nges pa med pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsam pa ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ bdag nyid 'grub pa'i sems kyis ni/ /zhes dang / dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di yi las rnams thams cad byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ sa skya pa chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa tshigs bcad ma'am/ tshig gi bum pa zhes grags pa der/ de la rnal 'byor rnam gnyis te/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang /

/mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam bzhag bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te/ /ma bzhag rnam pa brgyad yin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ci rigs par 'chad la/ de la 'dir rnal 'byor bcus nyin mtshan rgyun mar 'da' ba zhig gis thun gyi mgo gang nas 'dzin na/ kha cig skyabs 'gro nas 'dzin par 'dod la/ 'dir ni nyal ba'i rnal 'byor nas gzung ngo / /bskyed rim la yang sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po yang / phyi'i sngon 'gro gsum dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gsum mo/ /spyi'i sngon 'gro gsum po 'di la yang / sa lugs phyi ma kha cig mu/ nyan/ theg chen spyi pa gsum las khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir byed par 'dod na yang mi 'thad de/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas pa tsam zhig theg pa chen po spyi pa las khyad par 'phags pa sgrub mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang gi lugs ni/ sdom pa gsum gong 'phel du bya ba'i phyir bshad pa yin no/ /de la skyabs 'gro ni yul mchog gsum bla ma rnams la skyabs su 'gro la/ sangs rgyas ni bla ma dang tha mi dad pa zhal brgyad pa'i rnam pa can mdun na bzhugs pa/ de dag gi thugs rgyud kyi rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa sgom sla ba'i phyir rnam pa po tir gnas pa chos/ lha mo brgyad dge 'dun/ yang na rang bas bslab pa rgan cing rtogs pa dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa thams cad dge 'dun yin no/ /skyabs su 'gro tshul la spyir khyad par bzhi ldan gyi tshul dang / 'dir yul bla ma nyid la sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor mos nas skyabs su 'gro ste/ he ru ka sngon 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan he ru ka /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /skyabs 'gro tshar rjes bla ma rang la thim pa rdo rje phreng bar bshad pas byas kyang rung la/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ sems bskyed la/ shākya shrī'i mdzad pa'i 'gro bsgral ma'am/

jo bo'i sangs rgyas chos mchog ma'am/ gong ma'i gsungs las bshad pa'i lhug ma gang rung bya/ sne thang pa sogs kha cig skyabs 'gro sogs brgya bzhi ma byas na mi rung zhes zer na yang / de ltar byung na mchog yin mod mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la/ 'di gong ma'i mngon rtogs su dngos su mi 'byung la/ yig cha gzhan du don thob la mdzad pa yang yod do/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ mngon rtogs dag tu snga ma dang 'dra mod/ gnad kyi gsal byed dang ljon shing rnams su dngos su bshad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ a bhi dha na las/ le'u nyer lnga par/ yig brgya lha thams cad kyi sngags yin tshul rang gi ngo bo rnams gsungs la/ lha ni drug cu rtsa bzhi par zhal gsum phyag drug par gsungs kyang / nyer bzhi par/ 'khor lo sgyur drug gi gtso bor 'di ltar bshad pas de bzhin du bya'o/ /sngags ni spyir yi ge brgya pa zhes pa ni yig 'bru'i dbang du byas la/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya/ he ru ka'i/ rdo rje sems dpa'i/ lha so so'i ste bzhir bshad/ lha so so la'ang bzhi spel/ 'phags pa'i bdag 'jug jim gyim mar gsungs/ gong ma'i gsung las mgor spel tshul tsam gsungs/ bskyed tshul la/ 'phags pas rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed pa dang / ye shes dgug gzhug sogs mdzad cing / rjes 'brang dag gi 'dod pa dang bcas pa ni rigs pa ma yin te/ rje btsun gyi glegs bam nang gi yi ge dang mi mthun pas so/ /de yang spyi bor bsgom rgyu 'di ma yin gyi/ spyir brtul zhugs kyi skabs su cho ga gsum bskyed dang / a bhi dha nar mngon byang lnga las bskyed tshul yang gsungs so/ /gang du bsgom na/ dge brag pa gzhon nu dpal/ rang nyid der bsgom par 'dod/ rwa pa dag snying khar bsgom par 'dod na yang 'dir/ rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/

/zhes pas/ spyi bor bsgom par bshad de/ dbang skur ba'i gnas spyi bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /khrus la phyi'i khrus ni rdo rje sems dpa'i bum chog ltar bya la/ nang khrus ni/ yo ga nas stong nyid bsgom pa la bshad kyang / 'dir chu zhes dmigs gsal 'byung bas byang sems la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gdan la brtul zhugs kyi skabs su nyi gdan/ 'dir bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rten yin pas zla gdan du 'thad do gsungs/ gsol btab kyang bla med kyi phal cher du gsum du bshad kyang / 'dir gcig gis chog go gsungs so/ /sdig sgrib dag pa'i dmigs pa la blo dman na/ tha mal pa'i bshang lam sogs nas thon pa dang / mchog yin na lha nyid du bya'o/ /khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la go rim nges pa ni/ gur las/ rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /sogs gsungs la/ rigs lnga'i sdom gzung der dngos su ma bstan kyang / saṃ bu ṭir bshad do/ /'dir bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis so/ /dang po la/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba/ mchod pa/ rgyun bshags bya ba/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba'o/ /dang po la 'dug stangs ni/ las dang po pas rdo rje skyil krung bya yi/ 'gro ba dang / rta la bzhon pa la sogs pa byas bzhin du nus pa che ba lta bur bcos nas/ brtan pa ma thob bzhin du mi bya'o/ /bsam bya la/ sems dpa' yab yum rang la thim pas/ rang lus shel gong ltar mos la yi dam du gsal 'debs so/ /'dir chos rje bla mas sku rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bshad kyang / phyag bcu drug par bshad pa nyid 'thad do/ /de'i snying khar mtsho skyes dang rgyas pa ltar na/ nyi rkyang gi gdan can bshad cing / rtsa rgyud dngos bstan la de ltar yin kyang / 'dir drug pa la pad nyi'i gdan can gyi hūm̐ sngon po bsam la padma'i kha dog dmar por bya'o/ /hūm̐ gi mtshan pa'i don ni/ sgra phral ba'i bshad pa/ rkyen byin pa'i bshad pa gnyis las/ 'dir gnyis ka dang ldan no/

/hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi kha dog ni/ nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can nam sna tshogs so/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa'i yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom la/ bzhi pa ltar na snga ma nyid steng du bsgom mo/ /de nas na mo gu ru we sogs byed pa ni mus pa chen po'i rtsom la med kyang byar rung mod/ 'jug pa po dag gi 'khyar ches pa'i tshul gyis nor 'dug ste/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar nas de'i rjes su byed pa tsam yang ma shes 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /mchod pa la phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs tshig rkang bzhi phyi mchod/ de nas gnyis nang mchod/ g.yung mos gsang mchod/ de la ri dwags kyi mtshan ma ni/ zla bas brda byas pa'i dkar cha/ bdud rgyal nyi mas mtshon pa'i dmar cha/ chu ni dri chu/ sman ni dri chen/ rdo rje ni sha chen yin la/ ro ni bcud len gyi ro/ cang te'u ni grags pa nyid do/ /g.yung mos mchod tshul la/ kha cig sna bug g.yon du bsdus nas des 'khyud pa sogs mang na yang / 'dir nub byang gi grwa nas 'khyud rgya byed pa la bya'o/ /mchod pa'i tshig la/ 'di rnams kyis ni zhes pa ltar na/ spyan drangs la spyan drangs kyi mchod pa byar rung yang / saṃ ṭir/ gtso 'khor zhes bshad pas/ spyan drangs la bdag nyid kyis mchod par bsam mo/ /nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang pa gcig ni/ mchod pa mdor bstan yin pas bya mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa bdun po yongs su dag pa ni/ mtsho skyes kyi lhug pa bshad pa'am/ rin chen 'bar bar yang de ltar gsung pas de bzhin du bya ba'am/ yang na gur nas bshad pa 'di nyid bya'o/ /snga ma rnams kyang byas pas chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ yan lag drug par mtsho skyes ltar byas pas chog pa bshad pas so/ /bdun gyi grangs ni/ dge bar yi rang ba/ sdig bshags/ don dam byang sems/ smon sems/

'jug sems/ bsngo ba/ skyabs 'gro ste bdun no/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa ni skyabs 'gro'i yan lag bstan pa ma yin te/ zlos pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir dang / rje btsun gyi gur mchan du rten brten par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi 'di'i go rim mi 'dra ba yang bshad pa yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sdom pa gzung ba ni/ gur gyi dngos bstan la med pas/ de lta na bdun po yongs dag gi khongs su 'du'o/ /'dir mdzad pa ni rje btsun gyis sga ston la gdams pa dang yang mthun pa yin no/ /de yang ji ltar zhes pa nas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i bar/ rgyud na yod pa dngos su ma gzigs la/ rin chen 'bar ba na yod do/ /de rnams tshar ba'i rjes su dkyil chog 'ga' zhig las gnang ba nod pa/ gsol gdab/ rang thim sogs yod na'ang / 'dir mi dmigs pa byas pa tsam gyis chog go /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ dang por byams pa bsgom par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs la/ kha cig tu lha mo bzhi'i spro bsdu la thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad med bzhi gsungs kyang / 'dir mi dgos so/ /don dam byang sems la mtsho skyes kyi lugs ltar/ snang med bsgom par rtse mos gsungs la/ 'dir 'khor 'das dbyer med nyams su len na/ de nyid kyi lta ba skyong zhing / de dang ma 'brel na/ thun mong gi dbu ma ltar nyams su len no/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo la/ thun mong gi 'khor lo dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gnyis su yod la/ de'i don la kha cig na re/ sgrub thabs spyi la yod pa ni thun mong gi 'khor lo/ khyad par 'di la yod pa thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor du 'dod pa ni mi 'thad do/ /'dus pa sogs las rtsib bcu pa'i srung 'khor bshad pa'i phyir ro/ des na rtsa rgyud dang gur gnyis kar bshad pa thun mong ba/ gur kho nar bshad pas thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa 'di kho na khas blang bar bya'o/

/'di sgom tshul la/ rtsa rgyud du/ nyi der hūm̐ byung hūm̐ las 'od zer dang / /zhes sogs kyis thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bstan par phal cher mthun la/ mtsho skyes ltar na/ dang por stong pa bsam par bya/ /zhes pas bstan par bzhed do/ /de la 'dir rwa ba sogs bzhi ni dngos su ma bstan gsungs la/ shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /kha cig ni bla re yang don gyis thob par 'dod do/ /rwa ba'i rtsig tshul la/ chu rgyugs sam 'bum rtsig gang rung du bya la/ ngo bo ni nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa'o/ /tshad ni dpag tshad dam/ blos ji ltar 'khyud pa ha cang chung ba ma yin pa bya'o/ /dbyibs gru bzhi pa yin la/ bri bya'i dbang gi zlum por yang bstan to/ /yang kun snying ltar na zlum por bshad pa yang yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de las me 'bar ba'i tshul ni/ phyogs bzhi kun nas 'bar te rtse mo me lce gcig tu gyur pa'o/ /de'i nang gi sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ rgyas pa ltar na/ rwa bcu gnyis pa/ 'bring po ltar na rwa nyi shu pa'o/ /'di ngag 'don la yang sbyar na 'thad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i steng du mtsho skyes dang rgyas pa ltar na/ nyi ma rkyang pa/ 'dir pad nyi gnyis ka 'thad do/ /rdo rje de nyid kyi ni zhes pa'i don 'phros pa'i 'od zer de nyid la 'chad pa dang / 'od du zhu ba la 'chad pa dang gnyis las 'dir ni snga ma ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor la/ rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du 'khor lo ser po bskyed la/ brten pa ni 'khor lo'i nang stong par yod pa'i phyogs mtshams su bsgom mo/ /'khor lo stong pa yin pa'i khungs ni/ mi thub zla ba/ ḍoṃ bhi ba/ nā ro pa'i zhal lung rnams las bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul ni/ mi g.yo ba dang mtshungs par 'khor zhes pa yin la/ kha cig lha mi g.yo ba/ 'khor lo g.yo ba zhes 'dod pa ni ma go ba yin te/

lha ma bskyed gong du 'khor lo grub tsam nas 'khor dgos pa'i phyir dang mtshungs zhes pa'i tshig don khong du ma chud pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhung de'i don ni/ myur ches pa'i stobs kyis mi g.yo ba dang mtshungs te/ 'dra bar 'khor ro zhes bya ba'i don yin la/ 'di lta bu'i 'chad tshul shes na gzhung de la kha na ma tho ba gang yang med do/ /'khor lo de yang mnyam pa gsum dang ldan pa la bya ste/ dbus sogs la sbyar te bshad do/ /spyir 'khor lo la gdan gyi 'khor lo/ mtshon cha 'khor lo/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnams las/ 'dir mtshon cha 'khor lo'i khungs su gtogs pa yin no/ /yang srung 'khor la gnod pa phyir zlog dang / rang srung gnyis mngon rtogs dang ma 'brel ba dang / 'brel ba gnyis las/ 'dir dang po'i dang po dang / phyi ma'i phyi ma'o/ /'khor lo'i kha dog ni ser po ste/ kun nas ser ba'i 'khor lo ni/ rtsibs bcu de dbus rnam par bsgom/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig ler yang ser por bshad pas so/ /gur nas bshad pa'i rigs rgyas bsdus bdag med ma dang thams cad la thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor dgos la/ yan lag drug pa la byas na legs/ ma byas kyang rung / yan lag bzhi pa la mi dgos pa nyid 'thad do gsungs/ gnyis pa brten pa lha la/ gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i sa bon bhrūṃ yig la rgyu mtshan ni phyag mtshan gyi dbang gis so/ /khro bo 'di dag gi kha dog gi nges pa ni gur las gsungs la/ dza lan dha ri pas/ gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dkar po yin par bzhed do/ /gur du/ mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag pa bshad la/ cung zad sngo ba ni lag len tsam mo/ /phyag mtshan la rdo rje tho ba ni yu ba dril lce'i rnam pa can/ rtse la rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i tho ba yod pa/ be con ni yu ba de nyid la rtse rdo rje phyed pa/ padma ni padma dmar po yu ba dang bcas pa/ rdo rje ni rtse gsum pa gdengs pa'o/

/hūm̐ mdzad rang gi phyag rgya ni g.yas gong du byas pa bzhin no/ /gnod mdzes kyi gtun shing ni/ spyir rang rang gi khru gang pa yin yang / 'di ni de las thung bar bya'o/ /zhes dmigs bsal lo/ /bod bgres po dag gis khro bo 'di dag gi phyag g.yon pa na zhags pa bsnams pa sogs byed pa ni gang nas kyang bshad pa ma mchis so/ /rang gi ngo bo la/ gnyis med rdo rjes dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams khro chen yin par bshad la/ ḍoṃ bhi ba'i srung ba'i de nyid dang / sa chen sogs kyi dgongs pa phyogs bzhi'i khro chen/ gzhan yid tsam khros pa yin mod/ mus pa'i mngon rtogs 'dir/ dbus kyi khro bo khro chen du bshad pa ni/ sa chen gyi dpe ma dag pa zhig la dpe mdzad nas/ ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs su 'byung la/ de 'dir chud pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /ye shes pa zhugs pa'i skabs su/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu srung 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren dgos te/ dper na/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren pa bzhin no/ /de nas gdan bzhi nas bshad pa'i arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'dir bu lugs pa dag yo ga ltar phyag rgya 'cha' ba yod na yang / mthe bong sprad bzhin du mchod pa rnams bya'o/ /yang brag phug pas skabs 'dir dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyi mchod pa mdzad la/ mi legs pa'ang ma yin no/ /'dir skye mched byin rlabs ni nges par bya dgos so/ /yang kha cig hūm̐ ma brjod gong du 'khor lo mi 'khor ba mi 'thad de/ grub tsam nas 'khor bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i bsam phyogs ni/ 'khor lo 'khor na sgrub bya 'khor lo'i rtsibs mtshams su bsam du mi 'dod snyam pa yin mod/ /de ltar na 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshe bsgrub bya la gnod pa cung zad med dam/ yod na de'i tshe bsgrub bya gang du bsam/ yang 'khor los bsgrub bya la gcod par byed bzhin du 'khor lo 'khor na bsgrub bya bsam du mi 'dod ces smra ba ni rgyal po'i bka' dang khyad par med do/

/sngags bzla ba'i tshul ni/ sa chen gyi dpe la/ bandhe gshin rje grags kyi mchan btab pa ltar na/ na maḥnas/ sarba'i bar 'khor los bsgyur ba gsal 'debs pa/ sarba nas/ ma ra'i bar gyi gnod byed kyi las byed pa gsal 'debs/ hūm̐ bcus de dang de'i khro bo gsal 'debs/ phaṭ dang pos srung 'khor spyi/ gnyis pas rtsibs bcu pa/ gsum pas bsrung bya'o/ /ming sba ba sogs ni ngag las shes par bya'o/ /sngags so so'i don ni zla zer bzhin bshad par bya'o/ /thal mo rdeb pa'i tshe/ chos rje bla mas bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes sogs bris pa ni/ 'phags pa'i sku rim gyi ched du 'ga' zhig gis bcug pa ltar mdzad pa yin pas ma byas kyang rung ngo / /dgos pa de lta bu yod na rigs pa nyid do/ /thal mo rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam pa ni/ gur nas bshad pa'i dmigs pa gsar bar bya'o/ /'dir bha ya na ni mi dgos te/ de ni mahā ma ya'i rgyud stong phrag bco brgyad pa nas 'byung la/ brgyud pa'ang rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba rnams las 'byung ba yin pas zab kyang 'dir mi dgos so gsungs so/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gur nas go rim nges pa bstan te/ sangs rgyas las ni rdzogs pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sgrub dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang la sogs/ /mngon rtogs yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs la/ 'gyur kha cig las/ sangs rgyas gnas bzhi zhes pa'ang 'byung la/ rnam shes 'byung ba ni 'gyur ma dag pa'o/ /ci'i phyir yan lag drug tu bstan ce na/ 'thob bya rigs lnga/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang drug yod pa ltar/ sgrub pa po nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas nas de ltar bstan to/ /de las sangs rgyas gnas zhes pas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag bstan/ kun tu bzang po zhes sogs kyi rgyu rdo rje 'chang rang gi lhag pa'i lha tshogs kyi 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/

gzhan ni gzhung bzhin sogs pas mi bskyod pa bsdus so/ /dang po la/ gzhi'i yan lag rgyu'i yan lag rkyen gyi/ gnas skabs kyi yan lag bzhi/ gong ma'i mtsho skyes ṭīkka dang / gnad kyi gsal byed du bshad pa ltar bya ba la/ dang po ni/ gru gsum dmar po/ dbyibs gru gsum gyi gtor ma phyir zlog pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lugs ldog gi tshul dang / lugs 'byung gi tshul gnyis gsungs pa las/ lugs 'byung gi tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud/ gur/ saṃ ṭi rnams las gsungs shing / mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang 'grigs pas de ltar du bya la/ rtsa rgyud du me dngos su ma bstan kyang / rnam gzhag rim par gzhan rnams srub pa las me yang don gyis yod par bshad pa ltar 'dir yang bya'o/ /de dag gcig la gcig reg pas gnas pa yin la/ de'i steng du bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa dkar por byed rigs zer na yang / sa chu sogs rigs lnga'i dgos pa na/ rnam snang gis thob pa'i dbang du byas nas bstan pa yin no/ /rtsibs rnams ni steng 'og tu mi bya'i/ phyogs nyid la bsgrigs pa'o/ /rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ bar do bskyed pa/ de 'dra ba chad pa/ bsre ba/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi rgyur 'gyur tshul sogs bzhi'o/ /'dis mngal gyi dngos gzhi sbyong ste/ phyag rgya chen por thig ler/ rnam shes las ni skyes pa rlung / /de las me ni skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor bas so/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di'i me ni gtum mo'i me yin zhing / brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor ba rdo rje phreng ba ltar 'dir bshad pas rlung gi bye brag la bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa la/ spyir gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bzhag pa 'di/ rgyud gcig nyid nas yongs su rdzogs par gsal bar mi 'byung zhing / rgya gar gyi bstan bcos tshad ldan nas kyang rdzogs pa med pas thams cad nas legs cha bsdus nas 'chad dgos la/

bod rnams la padma badzra gyis mdzad par grags pa gzhung gi rnam par bzhag pa mun sel sgron me zhes pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad par grags pa'i chos don mdor bsdus dang / rngog arya de was mdzad pa'i gzhung gi rnam par bzhag pa dang / yang phyis kyi mkhas pa bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i gnas lugs gsal byed bya ba rnams 'byung zhing / 'ga' zhig ni rigs sbyin gyi saṃ kra ha sogs kyis kyang legs par thon pa yin no/ /de la 'dir/ 'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta bab lnga yis bsdus/ /zhes man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa las 'byung la/ 'og la'ang padma nyi ma dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam pa gsum/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /dang po la/ bya spyod gnyis la pad nyi yod pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud la mkhas pa mi gsum gyis ma bshad cing / mtshan brjod der bsdud na bshad pa'ang yod do gsungs/ bla med phyogs la bshad ma bshad gnyis ka yod cing / gang byas kyang mi 'gal mod/ 'dir yod par bya'o/ /de'ang rin chen 'bar bar/ brgyad pa padma 'khor lo gdugs/ /de rgyab nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /sna tshogs padma dkyil 'khor rwa/ /me 'od rim bzhin bskor bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so gsungs so/ /de'i lte ba'i rgya sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rtse nas bskor ba'i re khwa dang mnyam pa/ 'dab ma la gnyis med rdo rjes 'bum ldan du bshad de/ padma 'bum ldan de dbus su/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /cal se ba rnams ni/ so gnyis mar mdzad de/ rtsa 'dab so gnyis kyi dag pa dang 'grig pa yin pas legs pa yin no/ /de steng nyi ma'i rgya ni/ pad lte dang mnyam la/ mdog ni ljang ser du bya/ dpangs ni gzhung rnams las bshad pa med do/ /sna tshogs rdo rje la zheng du cha phran drug cu rtsa bzhi/ lte ba'i rgyar zhe brgyad/ rwa la nyi shu ma dang / bcu gnyis ma gnyis las/ gang ltar na'ang de'i rgya dpangs rtsi dgos pas/ de la myang stod a rgya pa sum cu rtsa gnyis dpangs su 'dod pa dang /

bu'i bzhed pa sogs mi mthun pa yod na'ang / 'dir dpangs cha phran gcig dkyus la gnyis so/ /logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab bo/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rtsig mtha' nas mda' yab kyi bar la cha phran bcu dgu lnga cha yod mod/ de dag gi rnam par bzhag pa ni go sla'o/ /dur khrod ni thun mong gi srung 'khor gyi nang / gzhal yas khang gi phyogs bzhi'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng na yod par rje btsun gyi bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs su bshad do zhes gsungs so/ /bri cha'i tshe padma phyi thig la tshon dkar dmar sres par byed pa ni/ chos 'byung gi nang du padma sogs chud pa'i mtshon byed yin pas 'di yang rigs pa yin no/ /yang thun mong gi srung 'khor rkyang pa la bsdus te byed na/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi nyid gzhal yas khang gi rten gzhi yin la/ cig shos la ni cig shos so/ /steng thog phub tshul yang go sla'o/ /da ni dpangs la ci tsam yod ce na/ so gnyis kyi dag pa dang 'grig dgos pas/ ka ba gzhu ring thung gdung kheb dang bcas pa la cha phran bcu dgu lnga cha/ rtsig zlum dang btsan khang gru bzhi pa gnyis la cha phran drug drug tu byas/ gdung zlum la cha phran gcig tu lnga chas ma tshang ba bsnan pas/ cha phran so gnyis la cha phran lnga chas ma tshang ba 'byung ba de'i steng du sngar gyi bcu dgu lnga cha pa bsnan pas cha phran gcig ste so gnyis 'byung ngo / /sgo la sgo khyud sgo 'gram rnams las/ sgo'i rgyar cha chen gcig dpangs la mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bdags pa'i bstan bcos las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi lcags ri la dpag tshad gsum/ sgo yang de dang 'dra bar bshad pas/ de ltar du 'thad gsungs na'ang mi rung ste/ bdags pa nyid nas lcags ri la dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ sgo la gsum du bshad pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs/ gzhan rnams ni sla la/ rta babs sgo tshad gnyis la sogs bshad tshul mang na yang / 'dir gcig mar bya zhing /

bu ston bu'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī kar bla ma gong ma rnams sra ta'i rjes su 'brangs nas rta babs sgo tshad gcig mar bzhed de/ srad ta'i gzhung na rta babs kyi tshad gsal po med pas/ phreng ba'i rjes su 'brang na legs par mngon no gsungs bris snang ngo / /na re/ bla ma gong ma sra ta'i thig ltar mdzad na'ang / der mi gsal gsungs pa shin tu mi 'thad de/ der mngon sum du bshad pa la sus kyang snyon mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'jam dbyangs ral gris sra ta'i thig la gdugs cha phran brgyad du byed pa'ang 'khrul pa yin no/ /rgya gar ba dang / bod snga rabs pa kha cig sgo bris pa ltar slong ste/ sgo stod po cher grags la/ zung skyi ba sogs kha cig sgo dpangs cha phran gcig tu byed pa'ang ha cang dog la/ ma tis de lta na/ gtso bo cha phran gnyis pa'i sku la dog pa'i skyon yod do zhes rigs pa brjod par mdzad do/ /blos slong tshul ni/ rtsig pa 'dod snam rwa rnams bris pa ltar slong la/ rta babs mi lang pa ltar slong ngo / /rwa sogs mi slong bar 'dod par sems pa ni/ slong tshul gcig kho na thugs su chud pa yin no/ /blos slong zhes pa'ang mdun bskyed lta bu la bya'i/ shing dang 'jim pa sogs la byas pa la ni ming don med do/ /nang gi gdan sogs ni phal cher go sla la/ gtso bo'i gdan rtsegs gdan du mtsho skyes kyi ṭīkka yan lag bzhi pa sogs nas gsal bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rjes chags la/ gur las/ rnam pa lnga po bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ 'dir dag ldan du gsungs pa ltar lnga ste/ mngon byang lnga las/ rgyu rdor 'dzin bskyed pa sogs so/ /dang po la'ang gang gis bsgom pa'i don/ ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ de ltar sgom pas 'thad pa rnams kyi 'chad la/ dang po'i skabs su phyi skor gyi a li shel phreng lta bu nang skor la skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni rtsa rgyud du/

zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid de/ /zhes pa'i don yin la/ 'dir zla ba sogs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs dngos yin nas bsgom mam/ 'on te ma yin nas bsgom zhes sogs kyi dpyad pa'i gzhi ni ind+ra bhu dhi chen po nyid kyi ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i bstan bcos la snga ba der/ gal te mgon med skye bo 'ga'/ /rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes bsgom pa/ /skal ba bye ba brgya yis kyang / /de ni rgyal por 'gyur mi srid/ /gang phyir log pa'i rtog pa yis/ /gang la rgyal po yod min ltar/ /de bzhin log pa'i bsgom pa yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes dogs pa lan dang bcas pa gsungs pa ltar rje btsun gyis kyang bshad la/ des na yin nas bsgom pa kho na 'thad pa yin no/ /gzhan dag ma yin nas bsgom zhes rigs pas rgyal po'i lung yang dag min pa mthong bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs 'dren par mdzad pa ni shin du gol ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ srid pa'i rgya mtshor skal ngan byis pa'i lus/ /lta ngan mchil ba'i khyogs kyis 'dzin byed cing / /'jigs rung rba klong 'khyil pa'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /bshes gnyen khyed kyi rgya mtsho'i 'dzin khri lags/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa'i don ni/ gong mas yab yum thig le snol du mdzad pa ltar bya'i/ 'phags pa'i ltar ma yin no/ /'du shes gsum ldan ni kun tu dgos so/ /ha ha sogs kyis sngags ni rlung sgra la 'byung ba yin gyi tshig tu brjod mi dgos so zhes gsungs so/ /byang sems spyan 'dren dang mngon rtogs don gsal ltar bhrūm̐ sogs kyang mi dgos so/ /mngal 'byin la shan ti pa sogs 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa la byed pa ni mi 'grig la/ 'dir ni rgyu nyid la bya'o/ /mngal nas 'byung ba'i lha la/ gau rī ni kha dog dkar po zhes pa'i don yin la/ rnam snang gi dbang de ltar yin yang /

chos dbyings ye shes gzugs rnam du bzhengs pa'i stobs kyis nag mor byas pa yin no/ /gzhan rnams ni go sla la/ g.yung mo ni rkang pa sngon mo/ sum mdo dmar po/ lto ba dkar po/ snying kha ser po/ mgo dang lag pa'i dpung pa man chod ljang gur bya'o/ /phyag mtshan la nya ro hi ta zhes pa ni 'dod chags sbyongs phyir nya dmar po 'dzin par dza landha ri pas bshad/ dgra satwa ni me long phyed bkas pa'i rnam pa can/ dge slong dkar po ni padma'i gdan dang bcas pa/ kha cig lhung bzed kyi nang du byed pa ni ma go ba yin no/ /'khor lo ni rtsibs bcu gnyis pa sngon po/ rdo rje ni lte ba'i bar ser po/ rwa rnams kha dog lnga pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje yin no/ /lhag ma ni yongs su grags pa ltar ro/ /'bras bu rdor 'dzin gyi zhabs dang zhal phyag sogs la rin chen 'bar bar/ mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs su gsal la/ gzhan mtsho skyes ṭīka sogs gong ma'i gsung rnams dang / rgya gzhung rnams las rtsegs gdan nyid bshad do/ /zhal la gnyen tshul rgyal sogs/ zhal lhag ma bzhi ka rgyab tu bsgrigs nas gru gsum pa'i rnam pa can du byed pa ni 'phags pa'i dgongs pa la 'khrul ba yin la/ rang gi lugs ni/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa zhes 'don pa 'thad de/ rtsa rgyud du/ lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas yab kyi thugs khar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ 'god pa sogs yod kyang / 'dir yab kyi thugs khar nyi ma rkyang pa/ yum dang lha mo gzhan rnams kyi thugs khar zla ba rkyang pa'i steng du hūm̐ dang / aṃ sogs rang rang gi sa bon 'god pa nyid 'thad do/ /'di'i skabs kyi spyan 'dren gyi sngags ni gur nas bshad/ de nas dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod kyi/chos rje bla mas chu bzhi sogs bshad pa ni mi dgos so/ /gau ri la karṣa ya dzaḥsogs kyang gur nas bshad la/ de'i don za phod ma zhes 'byung la/

rngog pa dag gis za rgyan ma zhes par bsgyur ba ni 'gyur la mi mkhas pa'i gtam mo/ /dbang gi skabs su dbang lha rnams phyag bcu drug par rtse mos bshad cing / phyag mtshan yang bum pa bsnam par bya'o/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs ni gur nas 'byung la/ yan lag kun la zhes pa'i tshig rkang gcig po 'di rtsa rgyud na med kyang / rgyud 'bum pa las phyung ngo zhes mtsho skyes pa dag 'chad do/ /'dir lha rnams la chos rje bla mas sku gsung thugs byin brlabs chad cing / 'khor lo rnams dang phyag rgya bzhi'i sbyor tshul la 'phags pas/ mgrin par dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / spyi bor phyag rgya chen po sbyar ba'ang mi 'thad de/ rgyud dang gong ma gnyis ka dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag la/ phal cher ni go sla la/ lha rnams kyi ljags las rdo rje nas 'bras tsam byung nas bdud rtsi gsol ba la bshad ces kha cig zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ 'di saṃ bu ṭi las dngos su bshad pas so/ /yang skabs 'dir chos rje bla mas/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma la bdud rtsi 'bul bar bshad kyang myang pa tsam gyis chog pa yin no/ /bstod pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs zhes pa dang / ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rje yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'di nyid ni/ /bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs sgos blo can rnams kyang 'dod/ /ces sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi bshad pa mdzad pa gnyis 'grigs pas de ltar sbyar te bshad do/ /gzhan ni go sla la/ gtor ma'i skabs su chos 'byung gsum rtseg mi thub zla ba dang rtse mo rnams kyi mi dgos par don thob la 'byung la/ ḍoṃ bhi ba dang gur rgyan nas gsum gsum rtseg tu bshad pas rtseg tu byed pa ni de'i lugs ltar ro/ /chos 'byung gi nang gi pad 'dab kyi dbus su gang bskyed kyi gsal kha rgyud na dngos su med kyang kha bskang ste bya'o/

/thod pa'i steng du nyi dkyil/ de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsam pa la/ bu ston sa skya bu ston yin/ sogs dmar por 'dod pas skyon brjod na yang snga ma ltar bya'o/ /yang rin chen rdo rjes nyi ma'i dod zla bar bshad la/ na ro 'grel chen du yang de ltar bshad/ gter 'bum gyi tshe sngags gnyis ka las thal mo kha phye ba rtse mos bshad cing / rin chen 'bar ba sogs rgya gzhung dang / rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog las snga ma la pad skor/ phyi ma la kha phye bar bshad do/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ zhes sogs ni/ sgrub pa po rang gi dbang du byas pa yin gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i thugs kha las 'od zer 'phros pa ni ma yin no/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rje gtso bo rnams kyi phyag mtshan la 'phags pas 'khor lo dril bu sogs mdzad pa dang / phyi ma dag yum la gri gug thod pa byed pa yod na'ang / gong ma'i lugs la rdo rje dril bu nyid 'thad pa yin no/ yang kha cig gtor sngags kyi rjes su chu bzhi'i mchod pa yod de/ de yang 'dir mi dgos so/ /mi bskyod rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa 'di ni gsang 'dus las 'byung zhing / ma rgyud du 'don pa sgyur ba tsam mdzad do/ /'dir gshegs sogs kyi rjes su sangs rgyas bstan dang sogs bde mchog pa la 'byung ba yin la/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rkyang pa dang / 'dir ma byas kyang rung ngo zhes gsungs so/ /rdor glu'i don dran pa tsam byed na/ 'phags pa'i mchan nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bkra shis ni phun sum tshogs pa zhes mdo nas 'byung ba 'di nyid bya'i/ rgyal ba sras bcas zhes sogs ni/ mi la rab tu gnas pa la bya'i/ 'dir mi bya'o/ /de rnams kyi rjes su yig brgya brjod la/ badzra muḥzhes pas se gol gtog ste gshegs su gsol/ 'dir se gol ni/ mtheb srin gnyis kyi rgya bar gdong drug gi rgyud nas bshad ces gsungs so/

/zhes dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa'i dka' gnas kyi don mdor bsdus bshad pa zab don bcud kyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin bslu med du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab spyi dang / khyad par chos kyi rje mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub kyi rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun yid bzhin gyi nor bu du mas mdzes par byas te/ dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar myur bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas shing / skyes sbyangs kyi blo mig rab tu gsal ba'i rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtshos bgyis pa 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'dir smras pa/ 'dir ni rtsa rgyud bla ma'i gsung gi zur/ /nye mkho bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bris mod kyi/ /dam pa'i gsung la bcos pa'i kha g.yar te/ /ci dga'i ngan rtog mtha' dag 'dir ma bris/ /'di dag 'thor ba'i tshul du gnas na yang / /legs par bshad pa chu las rlabs bzhin du/ /'bur du byung rnams bsdus pa'i tshul yin pas/ /ma 'brel sogs kyi dogs pa'i go skabs ci/ /zhes pa 'di yang rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams kyis rtogs par bya ba gnad du che ba'i tshigs bcad do/

/'di sbyar dge dang dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /de la brten nas bstan pa rab rgyas shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /spangs rtogs yon tan skad cig gis rdzogs te/ /gzhan phyir bsam bzhin srid pa lan par shog /de yang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang / /bstan pa skyong ba'i stobs ldan sa skyong sogs/ /thabs mkhas sprul pa'i khyad par bgrang yas kyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don mang bsgrub par shog /khyad par bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /dri ma med pa'i ring lugs ngo mtshar gyis/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs ljongs 'dir khyab gyur te/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i 'phrin las de 'drar shog/ //sarba maṃ ga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ kye rdor mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i dka' gnas kyi don mdor bsdus bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
